features: CASY and ATD own-baseline surprises multiplied by calendar overlap fraction
fit: Two-feature ridge without intercept, alpha 25 square cents, coefficients constrained to [0,1], minimum eight earlier same-era complete pairs
cutoff: Target quarter end; earlier target outcomes must be published strictly before cutoff; each historical feature reconstructed at its own quarter end
missing: No imputation; missing peer or insufficient training blocks fitted correction
comparators: Unchanged production and 0.5 times overlap-weighted Casey surprise on identical scored quarters
metrics: MAE, RMSE, errors >=5 cents, ordinary-quarter damage, largest-miss subgroup and leave-best-gain-out sensitivity
selection: No consensus selection, threshold sweep or coefficient tuning on held-out targets; disagreements included
